description: No API key. Diesel, petrol and LPG prices at fuel stations near any point in France, Spain and Italy (cheapest first, official government feeds) plus the official weekly pump-price averages for all 27 EU countries with history since 2005. Price monitor mode returns only changes. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.001 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/europe-fuel-prices.

averageCountries.description: ISO country codes for the official EU Weekly Oil Bulletin averages (any of the 27 EU countries, plus EU for the EU-27 average and EA for the euro area). Use ["ALL"] for all. Leave empty in both mode to skip averages.

fuel.description: Fuel to price and sort by: diesel, petrol95 (E5), petrol95_e10, petrol98, lpg, e85, cng, lng, diesel_premium, petrol_premium, adblue, hydrogen, or all (every fuel the station sells, sorted by distance). Every row also lists all fuels of the

historyWeeks.description: Add the last N weekly prices to every average row (0 = none, up to 1,100 weeks back to 2005).

latitude.description: Latitude of the point to search around (WGS84), e.g. 48.8566 for Paris, 40.4168 for Madrid, 41.9028 for Rome. Station prices cover France, Spain and Italy.

longitude.description: Longitude of the point to search around (WGS84), e.g. 2.3522 for Paris.

maxStations.description: Maximum number of stations to return, 1 to 200.

mode.description: both = station prices near the point plus the weekly national averages; stations = only stations near the point (France, Spain, Italy); averages = only the official weekly averages per EU country.

radiusKm.description: Search radius around the point in kilometres, 0.5 to 50.

sortBy.description: price = cheapest first (ties by distance); distance = nearest first.

name: europe_fuel_prices
title: Fuel Prices API - Europe Stations & Weekly Averages, No Key
